Recipe previews use the same non-publishing evaluation. Duplicate costs, alternatives, station rules, identities and unrelated recovery rows retain their verified behavior. Independent observations verify every observed refusal, no-allocation census and recovery-independent trial size. All 46 regression groups, seven relevant Release tests and the existing scoped native startup and input fixtures pass. The anvil, remaining GUI and cold file or platform allocations remain open.
